item.title: It was a big night for doctors to win seats in Congress, riding the blue wave
item.description: Historically, most physicians who served in the House or Senate have been Republicans. In the next Congress, physicians who are Democrats made significant gains.

item.title: This woman defied lethal cancer. Can mRNA vaccines make that possible for others?

item.title: Do you know signs of a stroke? BE FAST are the words to remember
item.description: Sen. Chris Murphy is expected to fully recover from his stroke. The acronym BE FAST can help you remember the symptoms of stroke and what to do when it happens: Call 911 quickly.
